title: Physician on the website — from the home page to a demo request
description: Врач-нейроинтервенционалист из США впервые на сайте: находит терапию аневризм (COMANECI™), смотрит исследования, просит запись вебинара или демо. Регион определяется по IP сразу (решение 2026-11-10). Все страницы — реальные составы из блоков сайта (снимок в rm-pages.json). Заметки «по коду» — как сайт работает сейчас; остальные — вопросы и предложения.

items.title: A patient-centric approach to AIS
items.body: TIGERTRIEVER™ is the only active thrombectomy device – it is engineered to adapt to patient anatomy. Accelerate clot integration and reduce stress on the brain during mechanical thrombectomy procedures.
Unlike conventional stent retrievers, active thrombectomy can improve clot penetration¹ and facilitate smooth retrieval with adjustable radial force.

items.title: Bridging the gap in assist devices
items.body: COMANECI™ is the only non-occlusive and temporary device for wide-neck aneurysm treatment.
items.annotation: Над заголовком — версии страницы в других регионах, названиями регионов.

items.body: Minimize the risk and disruption to patients' lives with lasting results. COMANECI™ is the first active assist device – its added user control overcomes the limitations of conventional balloons and stents.
The temporary deployment of COMANECI™ provides the long-term support of a stent, achieving high packing density and 85% immediate complete occlusion compared to 79% with stent-assisted coiling.¹
items.title: require implants
items.footnote: Avoiding implants like stents is preferable to allow the brain to heal naturally and minimize long-term stroke risks and bleeding complications.

items.title: Complete visibility

items.body: Operator-controlled adjustability enables adjustable vessel conformity.
items.title: Proprietary active technology

items.body: >25% smaller than the smallest occlusion balloons³ facilitates access to complex anatomy and enhances stability.

items.body: After positioning the catheters, deploy the 1st coil loop; then deploy COMANECI.
items.title: DEPLOY

items.body: Close and re-expand COMANECI before detaching each coil.
items.title: CONTINUE COILING

items.body: Remove the coiling catheter with COMANECI expanded. Remove COMANECI.
